evidence: I get why you'd want to see the options first, but we don't have a standard menu of plans. It's all custom and the cool is the best way to figure out what the right setup is rather than sending something generic.
I will just reconfirm it and just really tell him that it's not about pushing him to do anything I just want to help him but we really need to make sure it actually fits to him because it's custom.

flags.summary: Setter booked a lead onto a closing call after deciding to waive his own doubt about financial qualification, on a colleague's encouragement and with a cheaper tier as the fallback.
evidence: I will say the fact that he's 23 did make me question financial qualification a bit, but, you know, as Chris was saying earlier, he was such a good fit, I thought I'd let it slide, and either way, I think we'll get him through on the primal year.
